text.en:
The sum of twenty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, to be spent at the discretion of the Secretary of Justice, for the purchase
of law books, legal works, publications, etc., and of library equipment for the Department of Justice.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1934.
